ei.title: The Public Mechanical Clock Promoted Western Economy
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: The Public Mechanical Clock Promoted Western Economy

fullPassage: Many historians have pointed to the significance of accurate time measurement to Western economic progress. The French historian Jacques Le Goff called the birth of the public mechanical clock a turning point in Western society. Until the late Middle Ages, people had sun or water clocks, which did not play any meaningful role in business activities. Market openings and activities started with the sunrise and typically ended at noon when the sun was at its peak. But when the first public mechanical clocks were introduced and spread across European cities, market times were set by the stroke of the hour. Public clocks thus greatly contributed to public life and work by providing a new concept of time that was easy for everyone to understand. This, in turn, helped facilitate trade and commerce. Interactions and transactions between consumers, retailers, and wholesalers became less irregular. Important town meetings began to follow the pace of the clock, allowing people to better plan their time and allocate resources in a more efficient manner.

questions.passage: Many historians have pointed to the (A)[insignificance / significance] of accurate time measurement to Western economic progress. The French historian Jacques Le Goff called the birth of the public mechanical clock a turning point in Western society. Until the late Middle Ages, people had sun or water clocks, which did not play any (B)[meaningless / meaningful] role in business activities. Market openings and activities started with the sunrise and typically ended at noon when the sun was at its peak. But when the first public mechanical clocks were introduced and spread across European cities, market times were set by the stroke of the hour. Public clocks thus greatly (C)[contributed / hindered] to public life and work by providing a new concept of time that was easy for everyone to understand. This, in turn, helped facilitate trade and commerce. Interactions and transactions between consumers, retailers, and wholesalers became less irregular. Important town meetings began to follow the pace of the clock, allowing people to better plan their time and allocate resources in a more efficient manner.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) significance=중요성, (B) meaningful=의미 있는, (C) contributed=기여했다
det.analysis:
❌ ① insignificance — meaningful — contributed: (A) insignificance(무의미함)는 significance(중요성)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② significance — meaningless — contributed: (B) meaningless(무의미한)는 meaningful(의미 있는)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ③ significance — meaningful — contributed: 원문 일치. 정확한 시간 측정의 중요성(significance), 의미 있는(meaningful) 역할, 공적 생활에 기여(contributed) ←정답
❌ ④ significance — meaningful — hindered: (C) hindered(방해했다)는 contributed(기여했다)의 반의어로 부적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) accurate=정확한, (B) facilitate=촉진하다, (C) efficient=효율적인
det.analysis:
❌ ① inaccurate — facilitate — efficient: (A) inaccurate(부정확한)는 accurate(정확한)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② accurate — obstruct — efficient: (B) obstruct(방해하다)는 facilitate(촉진하다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ accurate — facilitate — wasteful: (C) wasteful(낭비적인)은 efficient(효율적인)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ④ accurate — facilitate — efficient: 원문 일치. 정확한(accurate) 시간 측정, 무역 촉진(facilitate), 효율적(efficient) 자원 배분 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) introduced=도입된, (B) irregular=불규칙적인, (C) allocate=배분하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① introduced — irregular — squander: (C) squander(낭비하다)는 allocate(배분하다)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ② introduced — irregular — allocate: 원문 일치. 기계시계가 도입(introduced)되고, 거래가 덜 불규칙(less irregular)해지며, 자원을 배분(allocate) ←정답
❌ ③ abolished — irregular — allocate: (A) abolished(폐지된)는 introduced(도입된)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ introduced — regular — allocate: (B) regular(규칙적인)는 irregular(불규칙적인)의 반의어. 원문은 'less irregular'이므로 irregular이 맞음
det.tip: introduced(도입) / less irregular(덜 불규칙) / allocate resources(자원 배분)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 해시계/물시계는 사업 활동에 의미 있는 역할을 하지 못했다는 맥락. meaningless는 meaningful의 반의어
det.analysis:
❌ ① significance — 원문 일치. 정확한 시간 측정의 '중요성'이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② turning point — 원문 일치. 공공 기계시계의 탄생이 '전환점'이라는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ meaningless — 원문은 meaningful(의미 있는). meaningless(무의미한)로 바꾸면 '의미 없는 역할을 하지 않았다'가 되어 이중부정으로 논리 오류 ←정답
❌ ④ contributed — 원문 일치. 공공 시계가 공적 생활에 '기여했다'는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: did not play any meaningful role = 의미 있는 역할을 하지 못했다. meaningless면 이중부정

det.korean: irregular=불규칙적인 ↔ consistent=일관된
det.analysis:
❌ ① erratic: erratic(변덕스러운)은 irregular의 동의어
✅ ② consistent: consistent(일관된)은 irregular(불규칙적인)의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ③ sporadic: sporadic(산발적인)은 irregular의 동의어
❌ ④ chaotic: chaotic(혼란스러운)은 irregular와 유사한 방향

questions.passage:
(A) Many historians have pointed to the significance of accurate time <u>measurement</u> to Western economic progress. Without proper ways to measure time, trade remained disorganized.
(B) The tailor took careful <u>measurement</u> of the customer's waist, shoulders, and arms to ensure the suit would fit perfectly.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 measurement가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) measurement=측정(추상적 행위), (B) measurement=치수(구체적 수치)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 치수 — (B) 측정: 의미가 뒤바뀜. (A)는 시간의 '측정' 행위이고 (B)는 재단사의 '치수' 재기
✅ ② (A) 측정 — (B) 치수: (A)는 추상적 행위로서 time measurement(시간 측정), (B)는 구체적 신체 치수(waist, shoulders, arms의 치수) ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 기준 — (B) 단위: measurement는 기준이나 단위가 아닌 측정/치수
❌ ④ (A) 단위 — (B) 기준: 의미가 맞지 않음
det.tip: measurement: (추상) 측정 행위 vs (구체) 치수, 크기

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to make a process or action easier or more likely to happen"

det.korean: facilitate=촉진하다: 과정이나 행위를 더 쉽게 또는 더 일어나기 쉽게 만들다
det.analysis:
❌ ① allocate: allocate(배분하다)는 자원을 나누는 것이지 과정을 쉽게 만드는 것이 아님
❌ ② contribute: contribute(기여하다)는 도움을 주는 것이지만 '쉽게 만든다'는 뜻이 아님
❌ ③ measure: measure(측정하다)는 크기를 재는 것이지 과정을 쉽게 만드는 것이 아님
✅ ④ facilitate: facilitate(촉진하다)는 과정을 더 쉽게 만든다는 영영 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답

questions.passage: Many historians have pointed to the __________ (significant) of accurate time measurement to Western economic progress.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: significant → significance: 관사 the 뒤에 명사가 필요
det.analysis: 형용사 significant를 명사 significance로 변환. 'the _____ of accurate time measurement'에서 관사 the 뒤에 명사 필요, of 전치사구가 뒤따르므로 명사형
det.tip: significant(형용사: 중요한) → significance(명사: 중요성). the + 명사 + of

questions.passage: Public clocks thus greatly contributed to public life and work by __________ (provide) a new concept of time that was easy for everyone to understand.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: provide → providing: 전치사 by 뒤에 동명사가 필요
det.analysis: 동사 provide를 동명사 providing으로 변환. 'by _____ a new concept'에서 전치사 by 뒤에 동명사(-ing) 필요. by + V-ing = ~함으로써

questions.passage: Many historians have pointed to the significance of accurate time measurement to Western economic progress. The French historian Jacques Le Goff called the birth of the public mechanical clock a turning point in Western society. Until the late Middle Ages, people had sun or water clocks, which did not play any meaningful role in business activities. Market openings and activities started with the sunrise and typically ended at noon when the sun was at its peak. But when the first public mechanical clocks were introduced and spread across European cities, market times were set by __________. Public clocks thus greatly contributed to public life and work by providing a new concept of time that was easy for everyone to understand. This, in turn, helped facilitate trade and commerce. Interactions and transactions between consumers, retailers, and wholesalers became less irregular. Important town meetings began to follow the pace of the clock, allowing people to better plan their time and allocate resources in a more efficient manner.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기계시계 도입 후 시장 시간이 정시 종소리(stroke of the hour)에 의해 정해졌다
det.analysis:
❌ ① the position of the sun: 해의 위치는 기계시계 도입 이전의 기준이므로 부적절
❌ ② the direction of the wind: 바람의 방향은 시간 측정과 무관
✅ ③ the stroke of the hour: 원문 일치. 'market times were set by the stroke of the hour'에서 정시 종소리에 의해 시장 시간이 설정됨 ←정답
❌ ④ the flow of water: 물의 흐름은 물시계 관련이지만 기계시계 도입 이후의 맥락이 아님
det.tip: stroke of the hour = 정시의 종소리/타종

questions.passage: Many historians have pointed to the significance of accurate time measurement to Western economic progress. The French historian Jacques Le Goff called the birth of the public mechanical clock a turning point in Western society. Until the late Middle Ages, people had sun or water clocks, which did not play any meaningful role in business activities. Market openings and activities started with the sunrise and typically ended at noon when the sun was at its peak. But when the first public mechanical clocks were introduced and spread across European cities, market times were set by the stroke of the hour. Public clocks thus greatly contributed to public life and work by providing __________ that was easy for everyone to understand. This, in turn, helped facilitate trade and commerce. Interactions and transactions between consumers, retailers, and wholesalers became less irregular. Important town meetings began to follow the pace of the clock, allowing people to better plan their time and allocate resources in a more efficient manner.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 공공 시계가 모든 사람이 이해하기 쉬운 새로운 시간 개념을 제공함으로써 기여했다
det.analysis:
✅ ① a new concept of time: 원문 일치. 'providing a new concept of time that was easy for everyone to understand' ←정답
❌ ② a strict work schedule: 엄격한 근무 일정은 본문에 언급되지 않음
❌ ③ a complex calendar system: 복잡한 달력 체계는 본문에 언급되지 않으며 'easy for everyone'과 모순
❌ ④ an ancient trading custom: 고대 무역 관습은 새로운 기계시계의 기여와 무관
det.tip: a new concept of time = 새로운 시간 개념
